Batch crawl stream produces expected Page and Complete events

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { batchCrawlStream, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { maxConcurrent: 2 };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const urls = ["https://example.com/page1", "https://example.com/page2", "https://example.com/page3"];
  const result = await batchCrawlStream(engine, urls);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
